tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig rtsa nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig rtsa nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje 'dzin zhabs la btud nas// dang po'i las can la sman phyir// dkyil 'khor spyi yi thig rtsa 'bri// 'di la rtsa ba yan lag gnyis| |dang po la yang thig ring dang*// man ngag thig gnyis dang po ni// sa gzhi skyon bral stegs bu la// shar nub tshangs thig dang po btab| |lte ba nas ni shar ngos su/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam sgo tshad brgyad// cig shos ngos su bzhi brgyad bri// ngos gnyis bzhi tshad bya rjes bya// de steng lho byang tshangs thig gdab// de la logs gnyis bzhi tshad bri// bzhi tshad bzhi la bya rog rjes// mtshams bzhir bri zhing thig gnyis gdab// zur gyi thig ni rnam par dag /shar nub tshangs pa'i brgyad rtse nas// brgyad tshad brgyad tshad ces cha chen bcu drug gi phyed ka yin de dkyil 'khor che chung la dpag pas bzo dgos/ zur thig steng du bya// ngos bzhi btab pa bcu drug phyi// logs gsum gtub cing rgya gram steng*// rim bzhin thig btab bcu drug 'gyur// lnga po'i dbus dor mtha' gnyis bcad// drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma bgo// gru bzhir sbrel bas rtsig pa dang*/ */stegs bu pha gu dra phyed dang*// shar bu mda' yab rnams kyi thig /rta babs snam bu bzhi ma ni// g.yas g.yon cha chen gnyis gnyis la// dpangs su sgo tshad bdun pa nyid// bzhir bgo brgyad pa dbus kyi rwa// rtsa ba cha phran gnyis gnyis la// rtse mor cha phran zhi ba'i tshad// dum bu bzhi pa'i 'og gi cha// pad+ma dbus kyi cha gnyis po// chos 'khor steng cha gcig po ni| |gdugs kyi sa ru shes par bya// gyen thig rtsa thig nas bzung ste// rta babs steng gi phyi thig bar// tshangs las g.yas g.yon cha chen re'i// phyed gdab phyi ma phyed gdab pa// sgo dang sgo khyud sgo 'gram thig

/de phyi'i cha chen re re ni// cha bzhir bgos pa sgo logs dang*// mun pa ka ba ka rgyan thig /rta babs zheng tshad phyi nas ni// gsum gnyis gcig gis dman par bcad// 'di yi glang rgyab skor tshul ni// snam bu gnyis pa'i tshangs steng nas// cha chung phyed dang gnyis bskor zhing*// dang po'i tshangs las gnyis nas gcig /bskor zhing nang du zhi bar cha phran gcig gi phyed/ bcad// rdo rje rwa yi skor tshul ni// snam bu dang po'i tshangs steng nas// phred du cha chen gsum zur nas// ka rgyan rtse nas nang rwa dang*// gnyis pa'i tshangs nas phyed lnga 'am// lnga zur bskor ba rwa yi phyi// rta babs snam bu bcu gcig thig /gnyis mnyam dgu mnyam bya 'dod na// sgo tshad brgyad phyir gcig bsnan pa| |dang po gsum pa bzhi bzhir bgo// gnyis pa'i dbus nas cha phran gcig /bcad pas bcu gcig snam bu 'byung*// gyen thig rnams ni gong dang mtshungs// gnyis gsum bzhi sne cha re bsrings// gser dang shar bu rin chen rmig /mun pa wa ran mun pa dang*// shar bu rin chen rmig mda' yab// de rnams so so'i rgya tshad ni// tshangs las g.yas g.yon re rer ni| |gser snam gnyis ni cha chen brgyad// shar rin rmig gsum cha phran dgu// mun pa 'og gong bdun dang drug /shar rin rmig gsum cha phran bdun// mda' yab cha ni lnga pa'o// 'di nang gu ṇa ha ri ni// snam bu dang po phyed dang drug /gnyis pa gsum pa drug drug go// bzhi pa la ni bzhi yin te// lnga pa las ni phyed dang bzhi// drug pa gsum nas bcad bya zhing*| |bdun pa gnyis ni mun par reg /nang du zhi ba nyid du bcad// yang na rmig gsum skor 'dod pas// bzhi pa'i tshangs steng bzhi dbus dang*// gnyis nas bzhi dor gnyis bskor zhing*// nang du zhi ba'i cha ru gdab// rdo rje rwa yi skor tshul ni// snam bu lnga pa'i tshangs steng nas// cha phran gnyis dor ka rgyan rtse'i// bar tshad bskor bas nang rwa dang*// drug pa'i tshangs las phyed lnga'am// lnga zur bskor bas phyi rwa'o// rwa rtse la sogs gong dang mtshungs// mun pa gnyis mnyam gzhan dgu po// mnyam pas gnyis mnyam dgu mnyam zhes// lnga mnyam gsum gsum mnyam pa yi// snam bu bcu gcig rta babs thig

/cha chen spar ba gong dang mtshungs// sgo tshad gsum dbye brgyad du gdab// gsum bdun phyi dang lnga pa'i nang*// sum cha bcad pas bcu gcig 'byung*// gyen thig rwa rtse sngar ltar gdab// shar bu rin chen rta rmig gser// chu srin gser dang rmig pa dang*// rin chen rmig pa gser mda' yab// 'di la dbye lugs rnam bzhi ste// dang po tshangs las g.yas g.yon rer// shar bu la ni sgo tshad gnyis// rin chen rmig gser gsum sna nas// cha phran re re bsring bar bya// chu srin cha bdun gser brgyad la// rmig pa cha drug rin chen rmig /gser gsum cha bdun mda' yab lnga// 'di ni gnyis mnyam ltar dbye ba'o// glang gur tshangs mda' 'dzom pa nas// cha chen gcig phyin gcig gis bskor// sngar gyi sa nas 'og logs su// cha phran gnyis gnyis phyin nas su// cha phran gnyis kyis sbug chung bskor// gnyis ka'i nang nas sum cha bcad// yang na dbye lugs 'di lta ste// dang po bzhi lnga bcu pa rnams// phyi nas cha phran re re phyi// bcu gcig phyi nas cha gnyis phri// lhag rnams phyi thig rang sor bcad| |'di la gu ṇa ha ri ni// tshangs las logs rer gzhal bya ste// dang po phyed lnga gnyis gsum lnga// bzhi par bzhi dang lnga phyed bzhi// drug par gsum gdab nang du ni// zhi bar bcad par har mig go// yang na tshangs las g.yas g.yon ni// re rer shar bu cha phran brgyad// rin rmig gser gsum cha phran dgu// chu srin gser gnyis cha phran brgyad/ rmig pa bdun dang rin rmig gser// cha drug mda' yab cha lnga'o// rwa rtse la sogs sngar dang mtshungs// yang na tshangs las g.yas g.yon rer// shar brgyad rin rmig gser gsum dgu| |chu srin gser gnyis cha phran brgyad// rmig rin rmig gser cha phran bdun// mda' yab cha lnga dag tu bzhed// 'og ma gnyis kyi kyog po gsum// snam bu gnyis pa'i tshangs dkyil nas// cha phran lnga yi bzhi char bskor// de las phyed du cha chen gcig

/dor nas cha gnyis g.yas g.yon du// bskor zhing nang nas sum cha bcad// rwa rtse dag ni sngar dang mtshungs| |rta rmig gsum ni cha phran re// gser gsum cha phran phyed re mnyam// lhag lnga phyed dang gnyis re mnyam// de phyir lnga mnyam gsum gsum mnyam// lnga mnyam gsum mnyam lugs bzhi ga'i// rdo rje'i rwa yi bskor tshul ni// snam bu lnga pa'i tshangs dbus nas// gnyis dor ka rgyan rtse nas dang*// tshad des drug pa'i phyed lnga 'am// lnga zur bskor bas rnam par dag |de ltar spyi khyab phal mo cher// rta babs mda' nas mda' yi bar// cha chen bco brgyad cha phran ni// don gnyis 'byung ba kho na ste// rwa rtse'i phyi nas cha chen gsum// nang ma dum gsum gnyis pad+ma// gcig ni rdo ra phyi ma gnyis// dur khrod me ri'i sa yin no// sgo tshad dag ni cha chen te// de yi bzhi cha cha phran zhes// de phyed zhi ba zhes smra'o// nang du dkyil 'khor sbrags dgos na// phyi ma'i phyed tshad nang sgo tshad// 'gyur sogs slob dpon ngag las longs// dkyil 'khor so so'i nang thig dang*// pad rdor dur khrod 'od phreng gi// phyi nang dag ni dur khrod dag /yod med la sogs dbye ba ni// rgyud sde rang gzhung 'di ltar gdab// mkhas pas blo dang ldan la bslab// gnyis pa man ngag thig bya ba| |thig chen brgyad po sngar ltar gdab/ shar nub tshangs steng sgo tshad ni// brgyad dam bcu pa'i bzhi mthar thig /gdab pa rtsa thig de'i phyir gcig /gnyis gcig gnyis gcig gcig gdab pa// gru bzhi sbrel ba rtsig pa nas// mda' yab bar gyi thig rnams so// tshangs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon sgo tshad ni// gnyis gnyis shar nub lho byang du// sbrel btab gyen thig thams cad kyang*// shar nub lho byang brkyangs nas btab// rta babs so so la sogs pa'i// dbye tshul thig rnams sngar bzhin bya// des ni tshegs med bde bar 'grub// gnyis pa yan lag phrin las bzhi'i// thab thig man ngag 'di bzhin bya// stegs bu skyon dang bral ba'i ngos// thig chen brgyad po spyi ltar gdab// shar gyi tshangs steng mtho gang dang*// sor gcig bzhi bzhi'i mtshan ma bri// de dag zlum por bskor ba yi// thab khung thab dang mu ran dang*// kha khyer 'byung ba spyi 'gro ste// dus 'khor las ni mchu zhes pa/

/kha khyer phyi ru bskor ba'ang bzhed// de phyir sor gnyis lhag pa'i phyir// gru bzhir thig btab stegs bu'o// thab mtshan rgyas par rang gzhung gi// dkyil 'khor rdzogs par dgod bya zhing*// bsdu na thab dbus sor mo ni// bcu drug bcu drug g.yas g.yon du// ldan pa'i zlum bskor pad+ma'i phyi// de nang mu khyud sor mo gnyis// pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru sor phyed gnyis// lte 'dab mnyam gsum lte bar ni// shar nub sor mo bzhi bzhi ru// mnga' ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga'am// yang na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri// grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras// pad+ma dmar ram yang na ni| |phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser// lte ba dang ni bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo zhing rdo rje 'am// 'khor lo dag ni dkar po bya// kha khyer 'khor lo rdo rje yi// phreng bas bskor shing thab khung dang*// thab dang mu ran zla phyed dang*// rdo rje dkar zhing stegs bu yang*// dkar po'i tshon gyis mdzes par bya// gnyis pa rgyas pa'i thab la yang*// thig chen brgyad po spyi ltar gdab// shar nub tshangs steng mtho gnyis gnyis// gzhal nas de rtse nas bzung ba// zur thig bzhi gsum mtshan ma bya// thig bzhi btab pa thab khung thig /de phyir sor gnyis brgyad brgyad bzhi// btab pa thab dag mu ran dang*// kha khyer stegs bu rnams su 'gyur// thab mtshan bsdus pa de dbus su// shar nub sor mo so gnyis re'i| |tshad kyis bskor ba 'khor lo'i phyi// de nang sor gsum mu khyud dang*// lte rtsibs mnyam gsum lte ba ru// shar nub sor mo drug drug pa'i// cha dgu ldan pa'i rin po che// ser po bri zhing 'khor lo dang*// thab khung thab dang mu ran dang*// kha khyer rin chen ser pos bskor// grwa bzhi'i zla phyed rin chen ser// me tog ser po gcal du bkram// gsum pa dbang gi thab tshad ni// thig brgyad btab pa'i tshangs shar nub// sor mo bcu yi mtshan ma bya// de phyir sor gnyis gsum gsum bri// de la srin po rlung gi ni// zur thig steng du zlum por bskor// shar gyi thab khung rtse nas ni// me dang dbang ldan zur du ni// mtshan ma byas la thig drang por// btab cing de gnyis zur nas phyir// sor mo gnyis gnyis bsrings te btab| |slar yang thab ka mu ran dang*// kha khyer rnams ni bskor zhing bcas// de nas me nas srin po dang*// rlung nas dbang ldan bar dag gi// zlum drang thig rnams thig gis sbrel| |phyi ru sor mo phyed gnyis dag

/spangs pa'i grwa gdab de nang du// thab mtshan bsdus pa shar nub tu// sor mo dgu dgu'i pad+ma dmar// lte bar rdo rje'i lcags kyu ni// shar nub sor mo bzhi bzhi pa'i// dmar po dang ldan thab khung dang*// thab dang mu ran dmar po la// kha khyer pad+ma dang lcags kyu// so phyir bstan pa dmar po la// grwa bzhir pad+ma dmar po yis// mtshan pa'i lcags kyu bri bya zhing*// me tog dmar po gcal du bkram// dbang gi dgug pa'i thab kyang 'di// bzhi pa drag po'i thab khung ni// thig brgyad btab la tshangs shar du| |sor mo nyi shu'i mtshan ma bri// de nyid zlum por bskor nas kyang*// shar mtshan nas ni me dbang du// lte ba'i tshad 'bri thig btab cing*// nub tshangs nas ni me dbang du// thig btab thab khung de yi phyir// sor gcig gsum gsum btab pa ni// thab dang mu ran kha khyer ro// thab mtshan bsdus pa de dbus su// 'tsham pa'i pad nag 'dab brgyad dam// rtse gsum nag po'i lte ba ru// khro bo'i rdo rje sor brgyad pa// nag po 'bri zhing thab khung dang*// thab dang mu ran nag po la// kha khyer khro bo'i rdo rje dang*// ral gri spel ma nag pos bskor// stegs bu gru bzhi dbang ldan la/ /grwa bzhir khro bo'i rdo rje'am// ral gri nag po phyir bstan dgod// me tog nag po kun tu bkram// drag po'i las phran bzhi la yang*// thab khung 'di nyid kyis 'grub bo// de ltar rtsa ba'i las chen bzhi// thab dbyibs rgya tshad bcas pa yang*// grags pa che ba dag bris kyi// rgyud sde so so'i bzhed tshul la// 'di las go log ma mchis shing*// las kyi dbye ba bsam 'das pa// las bzhi'i nang tshan zlas phye ba// rnal 'byor phyi nang bzhi bcu yi// thun mong bshad rgyud kha sbyor las| |las phran bcu gnyis bshad pa dang*// dus 'khor nas ni rgyas pa'i tshad// drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bring du na// bcu bzhi'am bcu gnyis bsdu na brgyad// de sogs blo las 'das mod kyi| |'on kyang de dag thams cad pa// phrin las bzhi las ma 'das phyir// las bzhi'i thab thig gsal por bshad// gzhan yang rab gnas la sogs la// nyer mkho mnga' dbul ri rab thig

/ji tsam ran pa'i cha lnga lnga// phyogs bzhir btab pa'i cha re re// lte ba gzhan bzhi bang rim la// mtshams bzhi re'u mig cha ru dbye// de phyir bzhi tshad zlum skor gcig /nang du rgya mtsho gling gling phran// lcags ri cha gcig gdab par bya// nyer mkho pad+ma'i gcus thig ni// thig chen brgyad gdab mtshams bzhi ru// thig brgyad btab nas lte ba ni// ji ltar 'tsham pa'i cha chen re// g.yas dang g.yon skor de'i bzhi cha'i// ze'u 'bru bya zhing lte ba'i rgya// mnyam pa'i pad 'dab phyogs phyogs la// cha phran gnyis kyis mu khyud bskor// des ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad thig /rnam par dag pa 'di kho na// 'di tsam kho na shes pas kyang*// rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor la// ma rmongs blo gros cher bskyed kyi// de phyir 'bad nas bsgrub par bya// deng sang sngon gyi legs bshad dag /dor nas blun po'i ngag sgros dang*// lag len 'khrul ba'i mun pas rmongs// de dag sel ba'i snang ba ni// rgya bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad kyi// nyi gzhon 'char kha'i 'od ris can// kho bo'i blo gros shar ri las// 'ong ba'i snang ba 'di yin no// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ming tsam dang*// dam tshig dral ba'i slob dpon dag |sems can 'khrul ba'i lam bkri ba'i// bshes gnyen de ko e ma nongs// de ltar dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig rtsa nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba/ sngon byon rgya bod kyi mkhas pa'i legs bshad rnams rtogs par byas shing*/ rje btsun rat+na'i gsung rtsom spyi thig byis pas rtogs pa nyid gtso bor bzung ste skabs bab gsal por smras pa 'di'ang*/ skyu ra'i rigs las 'bri gung pa dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ bye ri stag rtse'i gzhal med chen po'i kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du mgyogs par sbyar ba las dang po rnams la sman par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
